cases.name: a person's key press, click, scroll and touch each send the presence signal at once
synthetic events, hover and pointer movement send no presence signal
continuous input sends at most one presence signal per interval
the presence signal says how long ago the input it reports happened
a single key press, pointer press, wheel turn, touch or text entry is reported at once; idle time sends nothing
synthetic events, hover and pointer movement are not a person acting
continuous input sends at most one report per interval and reports the last input when its interval ends
a report that failed does not hold back the next input
disconnect removes the listeners and drops a pending end-of-interval report
each report says how long ago the input it reports happened, keeping the first report at once
